name: Chart - Supply and Host Growth
description: Monthly cumulative listing and host counts from the dbt month spine. One row per month; values are cumulative, not new additions.

stages.native:
SELECT
    month_start,
    'Cumulative listings' AS metric,
    CAST(cumulative_listings AS FLOAT64) AS value
FROM analytics.mart_executive_kpis AS mart_executive_kpis
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND {{month_start}}

UNION ALL

SELECT
    month_start,
    'Cumulative hosts' AS metric,
    CAST(cumulative_hosts AS FLOAT64) AS value
FROM analytics.mart_executive_kpis AS mart_executive_kpis
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND {{month_start}}

ORDER BY month_start, metric;
